title: Flatness plus fibre depth at least one cuts out a slice that stays flat and finitely presented
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S locally of finite presentation, flat at x, with the fibre local ring O_{X_s,x} of depth at least one, the lemma produces an affine open neighbourhood U of x and an effective Cartier divisor D in U through x such that D -> S is flat and of finite presentation. The retained proof performs the reduction: pick any h in the maximal ideal of O_{X,x} mapping to a nonzerodivisor of O_{X_s,x} (possible by the depth bound) and apply the chapter's lemma-slice-given-element. Retained author proof at lines 6351-6355.
